Earlier WhatsApp allowed iPhone users to add a second account within the same app, and now they are reportedly working on expanding support to up to three accounts. Here are the details.

WhatsApp to Support Up to Three Accounts

Last June, WhatsApp officially launched multi-account support on iPhone, allowing users to add a second account within the same app.

This feature had gone through several months of beta testing before its release, meaning users no longer needed to use WhatsApp Business as a workaround to manage a second account.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp now appears to be working on extending this feature, allowing users to switch between up to three accounts without having to log out.

WABetaInfo reports:

The report also mentioned that each account would retain its own chat history, notifications, privacy configurations, backups, and media.

WABetaInfo noted that while two accounts may already be sufficient for many users' needs, for those who juggle different combinations of work and personal phone numbers, this feature could prove very practical.

However, this feature is still in development and has not yet been made available to beta testers, meaning it may still be some time before a wider rollout.
